english.title: Registered early years provider fail to comply with a welfare requirement notice given by the Chief Inspector of schools

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a registered early years provider to whom section 40 of the Childcare Act 2006 applied, failed to comply with the terms of a notice under regulation 10 of the Early Years Foundation Stage (Welfare Requirements) Regulations 2012 given by the Chief Inspector of Schools, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TERMS OF THE NON COMPLIANCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 10 and 12(1) of the Early Years Foundation Stage (Welfare Requirements) Regulations 2012.

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 12 of the Early Years Foundation Stage (Welfare Requirements) Regulations 2012 specifies proceedings for proceedings in respect of this offence may only be taken by (a) the Chief Inspector and (b) after the Chief Inspector has allowed a period not exceeding one month, beginning with the date the Chief Inspector notified the registered early years provider of the decision to take proceedings, for the registered early years provider to make representations.
(ii) Section 98 of the Childcare Act 2006 defines "the Chief Inspector" as His Majesty's Chief Inspector of Schools in England.
(iii) Section 10 of the Interpretation Act 1978 states that any reference to the Sovereign reigning at the time of the passing of the Act is to be construed, unless the contrary intention appears, as a reference to the Sovereign for the time being. As such, references to ‘Her Majesty’ and ‘the Queen’ have been replaced in the wording of the notes above to state ‘His Majesty’ or ‘the King’, although this may not be the strict wording of the legislation.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being a registered early years provider to whom section 40 of the Childcare Act 2006 applied, failed to comply with the terms of a notice under regulation 10 of the Early Years Foundation Stage (Welfare Requirements) Regulations 2012 given by the Chief Inspector of Schools in accordance with the provisions of regulation 11 of the regulations, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TERMS OF THE NON COMPLIANCE..).
